title: SAP NetWeaver Application Server for ABAP does not properly validate certain input values. (CVE-2026-109802)
description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server for ABAP contains a vulnerability where it does not properly validate certain input values. An authenticated user can send specially crafted requests that trigger an internal processing error, causing the affected work process to crash and resulting in system unavailability. This vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity.
